text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll share some with you. Half, or 
even more— tear off as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just... it's sweet bean paste until 
halfway through, but from there on, it's 
packed with hot mustard. You catch my 
drift, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, now what'll you do? Let's see your 
intuition at work!
